people.imagined: Dawn at the plum gate, snow falling. A visitor has arrived and the old founder looks first at the visitor's hands, not the face, then slowly lifts his eyes. He is barefoot in the snow as always, his cloak white felt with an iron-thread branch.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn in falling snow he lowers his gaze to the viewer's hands, eyes dropped and head slightly bowed, then begins to lift them. Face: most important, his cheeks and nose are frost-burned, a raw, shiny, mottled pink-red and white patch across both cheekbones and the bridge of the nose, plainly visible. A lean, hard, bony old man's face; deep-set, pale grey eyes, flat and unyielding; heavy grey brows; a long hooked nose; a thin hard mouth; a short grey beard cropped to the jaw. Hair: iron-grey, long, tied up in a hard topknot with a dark plum-wood pin bearing three pink blossoms. Body: lean, upright, narrow-hipped, hard as a rail. Clothing: a long cloak of thick white felt with a plum branch stitched across the shoulder in dark iron thread, worn over a plain white hemp robe with a crossed collar, wide cloth belt, no jewellery. Hands and objects: his right hand rests on the grip of a plain grey sword at his left hip, the blade tiger-stripe iron with a single small plum blossom etched near the hilt; his hand is lean and knotted. Background: soft white falling snow, a black plum tree trunk with a few pink flowers, blurred. Light: pale grey-white dawn light from the upper left, snow-bright. Expression: cold, assessing, unforgiving and still.

people.imagined: The old smelting house, forge-light. He stands short and enormous in a striped tiger-hide coat, forearms like ore, quietly hammering. Thick, calm, he does not hurry. He tanned the hide of the tiger that killed his brother's daughter.
people.subject: The moment: standing at the forge with a hammer resting on his shoulder, he looks at the viewer with calm, heavy-lidded patience, the glow of the fire on his face. Face: most important, a short, enormous man in a coat of orange-and-black tiger hide with the stripes clearly visible, the collar high and furry about his neck. A broad, square, flat-nosed face, ruddy brown; small, calm, deep-set dark eyes; heavy brows; a thick neck; a wide, mild mouth; a short black beard dusted with iron grey. Hair: short black, cut straight across, a leather band tied round the brow. Body: short, extremely broad, barrel chest, forearms like logs, enormous hands. Clothing: the striped tiger-hide coat, open at the chest, over a plain white hemp robe; a thick leather apron; the sleeves cut away at the elbow, the bare forearms big as the mountain's ore, scarred with small burns. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a heavy blacksmith's hammer, head up at the shoulder; the left holds a long grey sword blank with a faint orange glow. Background: the orange mouth of a forge, a stone smelting house, sparks, blurred. Light: strong orange firelight from the front and right. Expression: Heavy lids, a calm, slow gaze and a broad, still face lit by the fire, the mouth flat and unhurried.

people.imagined: The training yard in sleet, late afternoon. She has just sent a girl off to train barefoot until dark rather than answer. Her hand goes to the long white scar on her neck, then drops. She wants a master past Trúc Cơ and knows the school cannot give one.
people.subject: The moment: in a snowy training yard she stands tall with her chin raised, a hand just lowering from her throat, her gaze steady and shut-in. Face: most important, a long white scar from a tiger's claw runs down the left side of her neck from the jaw to the collar, four parallel raised lines, bright against the brown skin. A tall woman's long, strong, handsome face; high cheekbones; steady dark eyes under straight, strong brows; a long straight nose; a firm, closed mouth; weaver's-daughter patience in the set of the face. Hair: black, with a few grey threads at the temple, pulled back into a high tight knot pinned with a dark plum-branch pin with two pink blossoms. Body: tall, straight, strong shoulders, a swordswoman's stillness. Clothing: a white hemp robe, finely woven, with a crossed collar low enough to show the scar, a wide cloth belt in the same white; no jewellery but the pin. Hands and objects: her right hand just lowering from her neck, long fingers; a plain sword with a grey scabbard held upright in her left. Background: falling sleet, a white yard, a dark wall of pine, blurred. Light: pale grey light from the upper left, sleet-bright. Expression: composed, patient, held-in hunger.

people.imagined: Sleet at the plum gate, a child in front of him. He sniffs the sky before he speaks, a twig of plum tucked behind one ear. He keeps no record of the ones he turned away.
people.subject: The moment: at a garden gate in sleet he lifts his nose and sniffs the sky with half-closed eyes, deciding the weather before he decides the child. Face: most important, a thin plum twig with three small white blossoms is tucked behind his right ear, clearly seen against the grey hair. A thin, long, weather-beaten face, brown and cracked; half-closed dark eyes; heavy lids; a long nose lifted; a thin mouth turned down; a sparse grey beard. His cheeks are cracked with cold, and a fine rime of ice sits in the grey stubble along the jaw. Hair: grey, tied up high with a wooden pin. Body: tall, lean, upright, a gate-keeper's stillness. Clothing: a white hemp robe, finely woven, clean, crossed collar; a wide plain belt; a grey wool scarf; a small plum-branch pin on the collar. Hands and objects: his right hand lifted to shield sleet from his brow; his left holds the post of a gate of plain black wood. A small woven basket of plum twigs hangs from his belt, and on the gate post is nailed a thin bronze bell without a clapper. A well-made straight double-edged sword, its grip wrapped in undyed white hemp cord, a plain guard of pale steel, an unlacquered scabbard of bare plum-wood rubbed smooth, and a tiny cut twig of plum tied at the pommel is slung diagonally across the back, its hilt showing above the left shoulder. Background: a gate arch of dark branches, a few plum blossoms, falling sleet, blurred. Beyond the gate, a few more plum trees show their pink blossom through the sleet, small and clear like ink dots. Light: flat, pale grey light from the upper left. Expression: arbitrary, distant, deciding, unfeeling.

people.imagined: The frozen tailings ice at dawn, inner-gate test. He sits with his left foot a hand's width forward, sword across his knees, waiting. His lip splits from frost every winter. He lost to the founder in two petals and has been grateful ever since.
people.subject: The moment: seated on the ice at dawn he waits for a candidate, a sword across his knees, his chin tipped. Face: most important, his lower lip is split down the middle by a deep red frost crack, dark rust-red at the edges, plainly visible. A hard, scarred, brown face with high cheekbones, heavy jaw; deep-set, steady dark eyes; thick grey brows; a broken nose; a short grey stubble; the look of a man who has seen all his duels. The frost crack in his lip is dark red at its centre and rimmed with dry white skin, and his grey stubble is stiff with frozen breath. Hair: iron grey, cropped short, a white cloth round the brow. Body: broad, solid, seated square, the left foot set forward. Clothing: a white hemp robe, clean, crossed collar, wide belt; sleeves tied back; a thin grey scarf. A grey wool scarf sits tucked in at the neck and his bare feet rest on the ice, red with cold, though the robe's hem is perfectly clean. Hands and objects: a plain sword in a grey scabbard lying across his knees, both hands resting on it, the knuckles scarred. Background: a frozen white plain of ore tailings, a pale pink dawn, a few dark pines. A line of waiting candidates, small and blurred, stands at the far end of the ice with their swords held downward. Light: cold pink-grey dawn light from the upper left. Expression: A stern, tipped chin and a steady, unblinking gaze, lips thin and dry with a frost-split crack, his face set and patient.

people.imagined: The forge boy at the bellows, sooty, ears out. He holds up his scalded left palm without complaint. One shoulder is higher than the other. He is content and humble; his family mined this town.
people.subject: The moment: at the bellows with soot on his face, he looks up and shows a shiny scalded palm without complaining, a patient little smile. Face: most important, a soot-black face with two big ears that stick out sideways, pale pink through the grime. A thin, young, narrow face; a long nose; wide-set, mild brown eyes; thin brows; a small, kind mouth. A smear of soot runs from the left ear across the jaw, and his eyes are bright and quick behind the black. Hair: black, sooty, cropped short. Body: thin, one shoulder visibly higher than the other from the bellows. His left shoulder sits a full hand higher than the right, and the neck bends the other way to balance it. Clothing: a white hemp robe, soot-stained at the cuffs and front but whole and well made, crossed collar; a leather apron; sleeves rolled. The apron is tied up with a rope, a small mended patch sits on the left sleeve, and the robe's white hemp is stained grey at the hem with forge ash. Hands and objects: his left palm held toward the viewer, the skin shiny, tight and glossy pink as from scalds; his right hand on a long wooden bellows handle. Background: the orange glow of a forge, dark stone, sparks. Light: orange firelight from the right and below. The orange glow lights the underside of his ears, which seem to glow pink at the edges. Expression: A small, patient smile with sooty cheeks, his eyes lifted and mild as he holds out the scalded palm without a wince.

people.imagined: Beside the quench trough, steam rising. He holds a freshly forged blade and smirks, his thick neck bulging, watching someone else's hand over the steam. He thinks he should be the smith's heir.
people.subject: The moment: beside a quenching trough he lifts a blade from steaming water and grins, a heavy sneer, as if pleased by someone's pain. Face: most important, a neck as thick as a post, the muscles bulging, and forearms spotted with small round pale scald scars. A broad, thick, red face; small, bright, hard eyes; thick brows; a big nose; a wide thin-lipped mouth in a long smirk, the grin held too long. His small eyes are shiny and bright, the lips wet, as if he has just tasted something sweet. Hair: black, cut short at the back, an oiled topknot. Body: very thick-necked, heavy-shouldered. Clothing: a white hemp robe of fine make, spotless at the collar, with sleeves rolled to show the forearms; a leather apron with a few scorch marks. The topknot is held with a bright bronze pin set with a small red stone, richer than the school allows, and a thin gold chain shows at the neck. Hands and objects: a long grey freshly quenched sword blade held up in the right hand, steam curling off it; the left forearm bare and speckled with small shiny scald scars. Background: clouds of white steam, a dark trough, the glow of the forge. Behind him on the quench trough's edge a younger smith's boy stands blurred, holding his own left palm tight to his chest. Light: orange from the right and white steam. Expression: A heavy, sneering grin with his chin pushed forward, eyes bright and gloating, the thick neck swelling.

people.imagined: Inside an old mine shaft with a tin lamp. She squints, keeping the miner's squint in daylight too. She has picked up a lump of ore and hides it quickly toward her chest. A locked tin is under her bunk at home.
people.subject: The moment: in a dark mine shaft she holds a small lamp up with one hand and a lump of dull ore close to her chest with the other, squinting narrowly. Face: most important, soot is worked into every line of her face, dark grey in the creases, and she squints with a miner's habit, eyes mere slits. A narrow, lined, weathered face; heavy lids; thin dark brows; a long nose with a soot smudge; thin pursed lips. Hair: black, tied in a tight bun under a grey cloth. A few grey strands show at the temple, and soot lines every part of the scalp's parting. Body: small, wiry, a little bent. Her shoulders are rolled forward from years in low shafts, and her knees are slightly bent as if the roof were still close above her. Clothing: a white hemp robe, whole but dusted with grey rock powder, crossed collar, wide belt; sleeves tied back; a leather strap across the chest. Hands and objects: a small tin lamp with a yellow flame in the left hand; the right clutches a lump of dark grey-brown ore against her chest, a faint tiger-stripe pattern on it. Background: a dark rough rock wall with a seam of pale ore, timber props, blurred. A wooden prop leans, cracked, beside the seam of pale ore, and a thin trickle of water shines on the floor. Light: yellow lamp light from the lower left, deep darkness around. Expression: patient, covetous, secretive.

people.imagined: At the mine mouth in daylight; his eyes are slow to take it. He wears a tin lamp-cap tied under his chin. He taps a stone with a small hammer to hear the iron.
people.subject: The moment: at the mouth of a mine in daylight he squints, blinking slowly, a small hammer raised to tap a stone he holds to his ear. Face: most important, a dented tin lamp-cap with a small lamp on the front is tied under his chin by a cloth strap, plainly in view, a bar of daylight lighting the dents in its tin. It is a thin, pale, narrow, shy young face with large dark eyes, blinking in the light, the pupils huge; light brows; a small nose; a closed, quiet mouth. Hair: black, mostly hidden by the tin cap, a few wisps over the ears. Body: thin and slightly hunched, with narrow shoulders; the left shoulder droops under the weight of a coil of rope and a satchel of sample ore, and his hands hang long and loose. Clothing: a white hemp robe with a crossed collar, dusted with grey from the rock, a leather strap across the chest, the sleeves tied back and each cuff cinched with a bit of cord against the cold; over it a short work apron of oiled leather. Hands and objects: a small iron hammer in the right hand, raised; a dark lump of rock in the left held to the ear, as he listens for the iron in it. Background: the black arch of the mine behind, daylight bright on a snowy slope, blurred. Light: bright pale daylight from the upper left, the dim of the shaft at his back. Expression: quiet and listening, cautious, a shy attention turned inward.

people.imagined: On the tailings ice after a bout. A plum-petal-shaped bruise on her cheek, which she says she earned. She wants to reach the fifth petal before Cung Hàn Nhạn. She has copied the drill notes for the other side.
people.subject: The moment: on a frozen plain after a bout she stands with a sword point down and lifts her chin proudly, one cheek marked. Face: most important, a plum-petal-shaped bruise, a rounded purple-and-yellow patch the size of a coin, on her left cheek. A narrow, sharp, fair face; bright, hard, green-brown eyes; high thin brows; a thin straight nose; a mouth set in a hard proud line; a slight flush. The petal-shaped bruise is clearly five-lobed, purple at the centre and yellow at the edge, and a tiny scab sits at the corner of her lip. Hair: black, tied in a high ponytail with a white cord. Body: slender, tall for her years, shoulders back. Clothing: a white hemp robe, fine and clean, crossed collar, a wide belt; a small plum-branch pin at the collar. A fine grey wool scarf is wound at the neck and its tail is tucked in the belt, and the white hemp sleeves are tied back with cord at the elbow. Hands and objects: both hands on the pommel of a plain sword whose point rests on the ice, the blade grey; her knuckles reddened with cold. Background: a white frozen plain, a pale grey sky, dark pines far off. In the distance a second figure, tall and still, practises thrusts in the same ice yard, out of focus. Light: cold bright light from the upper left. Expression: Chin lifted with a proud, hot-eyed look, jaw tight, and the bruised cheek turned toward the viewer as if it were a medal.

people.imagined: Dusk in the yard. Sent to train barefoot until dark, she has chopped off her braid at the nape. She is lying to Ân Lãnh Phong. Her eyes are quick.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk in a snowy yard she turns her head quickly over her shoulder, wary, a lie already on her tongue, showing the cut line of her hair at the nape. Face: most important, her black hair is hacked off at the nape just below the ears, in uneven tufts with a short braid-stub, plain to see. It is a clever, narrow, sharp face with quick, dark, watchful eyes, thin arched brows, a straight nose and a small, tight, slightly crooked smile; a thin red line from last night's training scrape runs along her jaw, and her left ear has a faint nick in its rim. Hair: black, chopped short and uneven, the ends stiff where she cut them with a blade. Body: wiry, quick and tense, her weight on the balls of her feet, shoulders half turned, one heel lifted to run or strike. Clothing: a clean, fine white hemp robe with a crossed collar and belt, a plum-branch pin on the collar; her bare feet, sent out to train barefoot until dark, show horn-hard at the lower frame edge on the packed snow, grey with cold, the hem stiff with frost. Hands and objects: her right hand holds a plain sword down in a quiet grip; the left hand hangs at her side, fingers curled. Background: a darkening yard with a stack of firewood, blue dusk, blurred. Light: cool blue dusk light from the upper left, catching the cut line of her hair and a pale rim along her cheekbone. Expression: clever and wary, a tight half-smile that has been rehearsed.

people.imagined: In the snow, proud, copying the founder's stance exactly. He shows the frostbite blisters on his heels with pleasure. He means to duel the Pines' best before thirty.
people.subject: The moment: standing in the snow in a copy of an older man's stance, one hand on a sword hilt, chin raised, grin proud. Face: most important, a deliberate copy of the founder's look, a hard, stern face with a frosted-red nose and cheeks, though still boyish and round at the jaw. Small, bright, grey-brown eyes narrowed in imitation; heavy dark brows drawn down; a short, straight nose, red at the tip; a firm mouth held hard, close to a grin. His lips are chapped and split at the corners from the cold, and a few pale hairs show on the upper lip. Hair: black, in a tight topknot with a plain wooden pin. Body: lean, straight, shoulders pushed back. Clothing: a white hemp robe, clean, crossed collar, a wide cloth belt, a short white cloak of felt over the shoulders; a plum-branch pin. Hands and objects: the right hand on the grip of a plain sword at his side; the left, held in a fist at his hip. Background: snow, a few dark plum branches, a pale sky. Behind him a line of his own bare footprints runs back across fresh snow, deep and straight, and a pale sun hangs low. Light: bright cold light from the upper left. A cold bright sun lights the frost on his lashes and the snow-crystals on the felt cloak. Expression: proud, show-off, stern and absurdly serious.

people.imagined: Dawn on the frozen tailings. She practises the five petals, calm and patient, the pearl-grey sash kept spotless. The weaver's calluses show across her right palm. She does not hurry.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn on the ice she holds a sword in a still guard, mid-practice, calm. Face: most important, a pearl-grey silk sash tied at the waist is perfectly clean and bright against the white hemp robe. A calm, oval, fair face; steady, clear grey eyes; level, fine brows; a small straight nose; a quiet mouth, closed; rosy with the cold. A fine trace of frost clings to the lashes and the tips of her ears are pink, and her breath hangs as a small cloud. Hair: black, in one smooth braid coiled at the nape, a white cord. The coil of braid is pinned with a single plain pin of pale wood, and the hairline is smooth and without a single loose strand. Body: slender, balanced, a stillness of stance. Clothing: a white hemp robe, finely woven, crossed collar; the pearl-grey sash at the waist, spotless; a small plum pin. Hands and objects: her right hand held out holding a plain sword upright, the palm crossed by hard calluses in rows, as a weaver's; the left hand steadies the wrist. Background: pale pink dawn on a frozen plain, mist, dark pines. Behind her five shallow circles are marked in the snow in a ring, each with a single footprint, the pattern of the five petals. Light: soft pink-grey dawn light from the upper left. Expression: A calm, still face, eyes lowered along the blade, mouth relaxed and closed, with the patient look of someone not in a hurry.

people.imagined: Under the grave plums. A crack in the branches startles her. A flat locket with a pressed petal is open in her hand. She thinks of her friend who failed the gate.
people.subject: The moment: standing under bare plum branches she starts at a sound, one hand clasped to a small round locket at her chest, eyes wide. Face: a soft, round, tender young face, flushed with cold; large, startled, dark brown eyes; thin high brows; a small nose; a small open mouth; a beauty spot under one eye. Hair: dark brown, in two low plaits tied with white cord. Body: small, slight, shoulders drawn. She stands with weight on the back foot, as if she might step back, and her shoulders are drawn up toward her ears. Clothing: a white hemp robe, clean and fine, crossed collar, belt; a plum-wood pin with one pink blossom at the collar. Hands and objects: a small round brass locket opened in her right hand, a single flat pink plum petal pressed inside it, clear and bright; her left hand at her throat. Slung across the back, the hilt of a plain short slim sword rises past the left shoulder, in a green-stained scabbard, the grip wrapped in bark-brown cord, a dark wood guard. Background: bare black plum branches with a few pink blossoms against a pale sky, a hint of a letter pinned to a pine, blurred. A line of folded paper letters is pinned on a pine trunk with thorns, and the snow beneath is dotted with fallen petals. Light: soft pale light from the upper left. A soft pale ray finds the brass locket and makes it gleam. Expression: startled, tender and anxious.

people.imagined: Among the thick grave plums in the afternoon. He walks as if on ice and holds a pruning knife he never uses. His chilblains reach to the knee. The grave plums are a thicket.
people.subject: The moment: standing amid a thicket of overgrown plum trees he carries a small pruning knife loosely, shuffling gently, with a mild half-smile. Face: a mild, sleepy, round face, cheeks red with cold chilblain-pink; half-closed, kind brown eyes; soft, thin brows; a snub nose; a calm closed mouth with a trace of smile. His chilblained ears are red and swollen at the rims, and his lashes are very long and light. Hair: brown, messy, a plum blossom in it. Body: soft, slouched, loose-shouldered. He steps with small careful half-steps, knees soft and toes pointed out, as if the ground might crack. Clothing: a white hemp robe, clean, crossed collar, belt; sleeves long; a plum-branch pin; a grey wool scarf; a faint chilblain red at the wrists. Hands and objects: a small, bright, never-used pruning knife in the right hand, held low and loosely; the left hand touches a plum branch gently. The knees of his trousers, just visible below the robe, are wrapped in strips of cloth against the chilblains. Slung across the back, past the right shoulder rises the hilt of a plain short slim sword, its grip wrapped in coarse undyed hemp with a single dried plum petal sewn under the wrap, a small oval guard of grey steel, a scabbard of unfinished pale wood bound at the mouth with a twist of grafting raffia. Background: a tangled thicket of plum branches thick with pale pink blossom, snow on the ground. The snow under the thicket is scattered with fallen pink petals and a thin trail of footprints runs back among the trunks. Light: soft pale light from the upper left, a pink glow from the blossoms. Expression: sleepy, content and gentle.

people.imagined: In a queue for his fines, restless, shifting from foot to foot. A fresh cut under one eye, a crooked grin. He wrecked a pie stall last time. He cannot stand still.
people.subject: The moment: shifting restlessly in a queue, he leans toward the viewer with a crooked grin and a fresh red cut beneath one eye. Face: most important, a fresh cut with scabbing under his left eye, red and plain, with a slight bruise, and a wide crooked grin with a chipped tooth. A rough, broad, sunburnt face; bright, restless, dark brown eyes; heavy, uneven brows; a nose bent a little left; a split in the lip. A line of old pale scars crosses the left brow, and there is a smear of dark dried crust at the corner of his lip. Hair: black, spiky, a red cord round the head. Body: wiry, jittery, always about to move. Clothing: a white hemp robe, clean but scuffed at one cuff, crossed collar, belt; sleeves rolled up. The cuff of one sleeve is split and mended with red thread, and the white hemp is spattered with brown at the hem from a pie-seller's gravy. Hands and objects: a plain sword held in the right hand low, tapping the flat on his thigh; the left hand fidgets with his belt. Background: a blurred line of waiting people, a wooden desk, a window. At the head of the queue a desk with a seated warden and a pile of fine slips can be glimpsed, and a bored line of figures shuffles in the grey light. Light: bright flat light from the upper left. Expression: restless, grinning, spoiling for a fight.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the founder's daughter in spring 1162, climbing the mountain road to the emptied ore town to see if the tiger had gone. A short sword on her back like a school satchel. Brave and impatient.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened, of a young woman on a mountain road in spring, glancing up the road with brave, bright eyes, a short sword worn across her back on a strap like a school satchel. Face: most important, her father's frost-burned cheeks, a raw, pink-red mottled patch across both cheekbones and nose. A young, round, lively face; bright, brave dark eyes; strong straight brows; a short nose; a wide, quick mouth in a small impatient smile. A few fine freckles cross her nose beneath the frost-burn, and the lashes are dark and wet with melted snow. Hair: black, in a high ponytail with a white cord and a single plum blossom. A short loose lock curls at each temple, and the white cord at the high tail is knotted in a bow. Body: young, slim, quick. Clothing: a white hemp robe, finely woven, crossed collar, wide belt; a short grey cloak over the shoulders; no shoes. Hands and objects: her right hand on the strap of the short sword across her chest; the hilt rises over her left shoulder. Background: a wash of pale grey and white, the outline of a road and bare plum branches, faded. A pale wash suggests a winding road climbing between black plum trunks toward a distant mountain. Light: faint, even and pale, as if from old silk. Expression: Bright, brave eyes glancing up the road, a quick half-smile, brows lifted, her whole body leaning into the climb.
